item.question: How does laser cooling work on a centimeter-scale torsional oscillator?
item.answer: Laser cooling of a centimeter-scale torsional oscillator involves using a "mirrored optical lever" with high sensitivity to measure angular motion. By applying optical radiation pressure torque based on this measurement, the angular motion is cooled from room temperature down to very low temperatures (10 mK), reducing phonon occupation significantly.
